newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar, France sign security cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: Qatar, France sign security cooperation deal.

text.p: Qatar and France signed on Sunday a memorandum of understanding designed to boost security cooperation, the official Qatari news agency said.
Prime Minister and Interior Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa al-Thani signed the document with French Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre, it added.
The tiny Gulf state signed a defence treaty with France in 1994, three years after the war that ended Iraq's invasion of Kuwait. Paris is a major weapons supplier to Doha.
Debre is attending an international anti-drugs conference which opened in Doha on Saturday.
